summary.zh: 全新应用首发。更新源、插件市场与发布产物全部切换到新仓库（mengtian999/Bitjarvis），应用内更新历史自本版本起重新记录。
summary.en: Initial release under the new project identity. The update feed, plugin marketplace and release artifacts now point to the new repository (mengtian999/Bitjarvis), and in-app update history restarts from this version.

title.zh: 以全新身份发布的首个版本
title.en: First release under the new identity

summary.zh: 项目以 Bit Jarvis 名义独立发布：自动更新、插件市场与发布下载全部指向新仓库地址，更新历史从这里重新开始。
summary.en: The project ships independently as Bit Jarvis: auto-update, the plugin marketplace and release downloads all point to the new repository, and the update history starts over from here.

details.zh: 后续版本将在此基础上继续演进，此条目作为全新版本历史的起点。
details.en: This entry is the starting point of the brand-new release history; future versions build on top of it.
